text:
Asha (CS): Heads up — we have an incident impacting VPC/private onboarding. A subset of customers' embedding indexing jobs got stuck after last night's DB migration. Seeing delays/failures to complete onboarding. I'm compiling affected tenants and need an embargoed customer status note. Can SRE/eng confirm root cause & ETA?

IncidentBot: Incident created INC-2026-457 — Embedding indexing failures after DB migration. Severity: high. Bridge: https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-457

Marcus (SRE): Confirming cause: the migration changed a default write timeout on the internal indexer which caused some batches to abort and jobs to enter a retry loop. We've paused new indexing jobs and rolled back the timeout change. Reprocessing queued jobs now.

Liam (Eng): Rollback completed at 03:12 UTC. Requeue started; most jobs will auto-complete but ~20% require manual resume due to their state. Bulk resume tooling in progress, ETA ~2.5h for full catch-up. Will post per-tenant list in the shared folder.

Asha (CS): Thanks — for comms I need: 1) short customer-facing status for high-touch accounts, 2) per-tenant affected list + ETA, 3) recommended credit/comp plan. Drafting note in ~15m.

Jorge (CS Manager): Recommend offering one week free dedicated capacity credit or a $500 onboarding credit for heavily impacted customers. Also propose office hours tomorrow 9–11am PT for live troubleshooting. @Priya can you handle FR/DE translations?

Priya (SE): I can. Also here's a lightweight troubleshooting check we can share with customers: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/indexing/status``` Returns state + last_error.

Marcus (SRE): Per-tenant ETA snapshot (pushed to /shared/cs/emb-index-affected.csv): tenant-alpha ~30m, tenant-beta manual resume scheduled 45m, tenant-gamma reprocessing in progress ~90m, tenant-delta requires data scrub/manual retry ~3–4h. Will keep updating.

Asha (CS): Draft status (short): 'We're aware of an issue affecting embedding indexing for some private/VPC customers following a DB migration. We're actively reprocessing jobs; most tenants should recover within 3 hours. Dedicated support and onboarding credits available — your CS rep will follow up with tenant-specific ETA.' Thoughts?

Priya (SE): Add a reassurance line: 'No model weights or user data were lost; this is an indexing state/regeneration issue.'

Liam (Eng): Confirmed — no model artifacts lost. Root cause and full timeline in RCA later today.

Asha (CS): I'll send to priority customers in ~20m once per-tenant ETAs are attached. Need a canned support reply we can paste into Zendesk.

Marcus (SRE): Pushed a support template to /shared/cs/templates/emb-index-incident.txt. Suggested text: 'We're aware of an indexing issue after a DB migration. Our team is reprocessing your indexing jobs; expected recovery for most tenants: <ETA>. If retries persist past <threshold>, run the check above and open a ticket with the job id.'

Asha (CS): Perfect. After messages go out we'll schedule office hours and collect feedback during the session. Priya — please translate FR/DE and drop in the shared folder. Jorge — approve the credit wording?

Jorge (CS Manager): Approved. Please include the opt-in for a 1-week capacity credit or a one-time onboarding credit in the email. Also add an explicit escalation path for renewals flagged as at-risk.

Asha (CS): Will do. Thanks everyone — sending the note after I attach the CSV + ETA column. Will follow up here with the final sent copy and list of accounts reached. :heart:'
